name: Mini Pulse Cannon
doc: Mini Pulse Cannon (Droma's enemy attack): the master and the main task - a muzzle layout at a point on the caster's skeleton with charge sparks flying into it, the beam layout from it to the target (aiming down, then level, stretched, its texture scrolling), the impact and ground layouts at the target, the sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag286_mini_pulse_cannon.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The main task's timeline: the sound, the muzzle and the beam for a number of ticks, the impact layouts, the damage (action 0's first target), the end

parts.title: Muzzle
parts.doc: A layout at the muzzle point (an offset on a bone of the caster), turned with the caster

parts.title: Beam
parts.doc: A layout from the muzzle point to the target: it aims down at first, then levels off, stretched along its way, its texture scrolling

parts.title: Impact
parts.doc: Two layouts at the target facing the muzzle: one at its effect point, one at its height

parts.title: Charge sparks
parts.doc: Sparks round the muzzle point on the beam's first ticks, flying back into it

groups.label: Angle random
groups.doc: A random angle added to each spark's

groups.label: Radius
groups.doc: Its distance from the muzzle point, at random

groups.label: Depth
groups.doc: Its offset along the muzzle's axis, at random

params.doc: At the main task's sound tick

params.label: Sound tick
params.doc: The sound at this tick of the main task

params.label: Beam tick
params.doc: The muzzle and the beam from this tick of the main task (their ticks count from it)

params.label: Beam ticks

params.label: Impact tick

params.label: Impact ticks

params.label: Damage tick

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Muzzle
params.doc: The prim-model layout muzzle at the muzzle point, turned with the caster (its models' animation)

params.label: Muzzle point
params.doc: The muzzle point: an offset (x, y, z) on a bone of the caster (8 bytes: x, y, z, bone; an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Beam
params.doc: The prim-model layout beam from the muzzle point to the target, stretched along its way (its models' animation)

params.label: Depth

params.label: Drop from
params.doc: The beam aims from the muzzle at the target's height until this beam tick, then levels off

params.label: Drop until
params.doc: Level at this beam tick (after Drop from)

params.label: Stretch from
params.doc: From this beam tick the beam's length is the distance / 2^Stretch shift (before: its model's)

params.label: Stretch shift
params.doc: (the game's 2: a quarter)

params.label: Long from
params.doc: From this beam tick the distance / 2^Long shift

params.label: Long shift
params.doc: (the game's 1: a half)

params.label: Texture scroll
params.doc: Its objects 0 / 1 scroll their texture by this x (beam tick & 3)

params.label: Impact
params.doc: The prim-model layout impact at the target, facing the muzzle (its models' animation)

params.label: Ground
params.doc: The prim-model layout ground, the same at the target's height (its models' animation)

params.label: Ground depth
params.doc: The ground layout's depth offset

params.label: Spark

params.label: Ticks

params.label: A tick

params.label: Life

params.label: Distance
